headline: A personal cancer vaccine helps stop skin cancer from coming back

choices: The drug companies MSD and Moderna

When they were ten years old

questions.prompt: Where does the information for each vaccine come from?

hintI18n.de: Es braucht mehr Zeit, um zu sehen, ob die Patienten länger leben.
